articles.title: AEIOU: A Unified Defense Framework against NSFW Prompts in Text-to-Image Models
articles.abstract: As text-to-image (T2I) models advance and gain widespread adoption, their associated safety concerns are becoming increasingly critical. Malicious users exploit these models to generate Not-Safe-for-Work (NSFW) images using harmful or adversarial prompts, underscoring the need for effective safeguards to ensure the integrity and compliance of model outputs. However, existing detection methods often exhibit low accuracy and inefficiency. In this paper, we propose AEIOU, a defense framework that is adaptable, efficient, interpretable, optimizable, and unified against NSFW prompts in T2I models. AEIOU extracts NSFW features from the hidden states of the model's text encoder, utilizing the separable nature of these features to detect NSFW prompts. The detection process is efficient, requiring minimal inference time. AEIOU also offers real-time interpretation of results and supports optimization through data augmentation techniques. The framework is versatile, accommodating various T2I architectures. Our extensive experiments show that AEIOU significantly outperforms both commercial and open-source moderation tools, achieving over 95\% accuracy across all datasets and improving efficiency by at least tenfold. It effectively counters adaptive attacks and excels in few-shot and multi-label scenarios.
articles.titleCn: AEIOU：一种针对文本到图像模型中不雅提示的统一防御框架
articles.abstractCn: 随着文本到图像（T2I）模型不断进步并得到广泛应用，其相关的安全问题日益凸显。恶意用户利用这些模型通过有害或对抗性提示生成不适合在工作场合观看（NSFW）的图像，这凸显了需要有效的安全防护措施来确保模型输出的完整性和合规性。然而，现有的检测方法往往准确率低且效率低下。在本文中，我们提出了AEIOU，一个针对T2I模型中NSFW提示的适应性、高效性、可解释性、可优化性和统一性防御框架。AEIOU从模型文本编码器的隐藏状态中提取NSFW特征，利用这些特征的分离性来检测NSFW提示。检测过程高效，仅需极短的推理时间。AEIOU还提供实时结果解释，并支持通过数据增强技术进行优化。该框架具有通用性，可兼容多种T2I架构。我们的大量实验表明，AEIOU在商业和开源审核工具方面均表现显著优于，在所有数据集上准确率均超过95%，效率提升至少十倍。它能有效应对自适应攻击，并在少样本和多标签场景中表现优异。

articles.title: Are LLM Agents Behaviorally Coherent? A Latent Profiling Approach for Social Simulation
articles.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly proposed as substitutes for human participants in social research, usually on the strength of survey responses that match those of the humans they represent. We argue that such output-level alignment is not enough. Drawing on the behavioral sciences, we propose Latent Profiling, a framework for testing behavioral coherence: whether an agent's conversational behavior follows, as human behavioral models predict, from its own latent profile elicited by short surveys. As a case study, we test six hypotheses about preference, openness and agreement across nine open models. Agents reproduce surface-level trends but systematically fail in-depth tests: they are not behaviorally coherent, even when their individual responses look human. Latent Profiling thus offers a theory-grounded instrument for a behavioral science of LLMs.
articles.titleCn: LLM代理在行为上是否一致？一种用于社交模拟的潜在分析方法
articles.abstractCn: 随着社会研究越来越倾向于使用大型语言模型（LLM）代理替代人类参与者，人们通常基于这些代理的调研回答与人类相似这一点来支持这一做法。我们主张这种输出层面的匹配并不足够。借鉴行为科学，我们提出了潜在画像（Latent Profiling）这一框架，用于测试行为一致性：即代理的对话行为是否如人类行为模型所预测的那样，源自于由短期调研激发的其自身潜在画像。作为案例研究，我们测试了九个开放模型在偏好、开放性和协议性方面的六个假设。代理能够复制表层趋势，但在深入测试中系统性地失败：即使它们的个体回答看似人类，它们在行为上仍然缺乏一致性。因此，潜在画像为LLM的行为科学研究提供了一种基于理论的工具。

articles.title: Representational Similarity Alignment of Figurative Language in Humans and Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce judgments similar to those of humans, but their interpretation of figurative language remains unclear. We compared human participants and four instruction-tuned LLMs (GPT-4, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.2, and Mistral-7B) on their ratings of 240 dialogue-based sentences spanning six linguistic traits: conventionality, sarcasm, funny, emotion, idiomacy, and Gen Z slang. While humans and LLMs were strongly aligned at the surface level, differences emerged in representational similarity patterns, particularly in idiomacy and Gen Z slang. GPT-4 showed the closest alignment to humans, though all models differed at the representational level, suggesting that similar outputs may arise from different underlying language representations. We also examined the relationship between model scale and representational similarity using the Gemma model series (Gemma-2-9B-IT, Gemma-3-27B-IT, and Gemma-4-31B-IT), and found that representational similarity patterns were largely unaffected by model size.
articles.titleCn: 人类与大语言模型中比喻语言的表征相似性对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常能生成与人类相似的判断，但它们对隐喻语言的理解仍然不明确。我们比较了人类参与者和四个指令微调的大型语言模型（GPT-4、Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.2和Mistral-7B）在评价240个基于对话的句子时的表现，这些句子涵盖了六种语言特征：常规性、讽刺、幽默、情感、习语性和Z世代俚语。虽然人类和LLMs在表面层次上高度一致，但在表示相似性模式上存在差异，尤其是在习语性和Z世代俚语方面。GPT-4与人类最为接近，尽管所有模型在表示层次上都有差异，这表明相似的输出可能源于不同的底层语言表示。我们还使用Gemma模型系列（Gemma-2-9B-IT、Gemma-3-27B-IT和Gemma-4-31B-IT）考察了模型规模与表示相似性之间的关系，发现表示相似性模式基本不受模型大小的影响。

articles.title: VERGE: Formal Refinement and Guidance Engine for Verifiable LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Despite the syntactic fluency of Large Language Models (LLMs), ensuring their logical correctness in high-stakes domains remains a fundamental challenge. We present a neurosymbolic framework that combines LLMs with SMT solvers to produce verification-guided answers through iterative refinement. Our approach decomposes LLM outputs into atomic claims, autoformalizes them into first-order logic, and verifies their logical consistency using automated theorem proving. We introduce three key innovations: (1) multi-model consensus via formal semantic equivalence checking to ensure logic-level alignment between candidates, eliminating the syntactic bias of surface-form metrics, (2) semantic routing that directs different claim types to appropriate verification strategies: symbolic solvers for logical claims and LLM ensembles for commonsense reasoning, and (3) precise logical error localization via Minimal Correction Subsets (MCS), which pinpoint the exact subset of claims to revise, transforming binary failure signals into actionable feedback. Our framework classifies claims by their logical status and aggregates multiple verification signals into a unified score with variance-based penalty. The system iteratively refines answers using structured feedback until acceptance criteria are met or convergence is achieved. This hybrid approach delivers formal guarantees where possible and consensus verification elsewhere, advancing trustworthy AI. With the GPT-OSS-120B model, VERGE demonstrates an average performance uplift of 18.7% at convergence across a set of reasoning benchmarks compared to single-pass approaches.
articles.titleCn: 边缘：可验证大型语言模型推理的正式精炼与指导引擎
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在句法流畅性方面表现出色，但在高风险领域中确保其逻辑正确性仍然是一个基本挑战。我们提出了一种神经符号框架，该框架结合LLMs与SMT求解器，通过迭代优化生成验证引导的答案。我们的方法将LLM的输出分解为原子断言，自动将其形式化为一阶逻辑，并使用自动定理证明来验证其逻辑一致性。我们引入了三项关键创新：（1）通过形式语义等价性检查实现多模型共识，确保候选者在逻辑层面上的对齐，消除表面形式指标带来的句法偏差；（2）语义路由，将不同类型的断言引导至适当的验证策略：逻辑断言使用符号求解器，常识推理使用LLM集成；（3）通过最小修正子集（MCS）实现精确的逻辑错误定位，准确识别需要修改的断言子集，将二元失败信号转化为可操作的反馈。我们的框架根据断言的逻辑状态进行分类，并基于方差进行惩罚，将多个验证信号聚合成统一分数。系统使用结构化反馈迭代优化答案，直至满足接受标准或达到收敛。这种混合方法在可能的情况下提供形式化保证，在其他情况下进行共识验证，从而推进可信人工智能的发展。使用GPT-OSS-120B模型，VERGE在一系列推理基准测试中，与单次通过方法相比，在收敛时平均性能提升了18.7%。

articles.title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
articles.abstract: Scientific discovery is an extended process of ideation -- surveying prior work, forming hypotheses, and refining reasoning -- yet existing LLM research agents treat this phase as a brief preamble despite its central role in research. We introduce SciSense, a sensemaking-grounded framework that operationalizes ideation as a structured sequence of eight cognitive stages (Pirolli and Card, 2005). We construct SciSense-Traj, a dataset of 120K citation-conditioned research trajectories in two modes: Hindsight, where an LLM reconstructs the ideation path from a paper's cited works to the paper itself, and Foresight, where the LLM proposes novel directions from the same citations. We distill these into SciSense-LM, a family of sensemaking LLMs spanning 3B to 70B parameters. Contrary to the assumption that looser supervision promotes exploration, Hindsight-trained models improve trajectory quality by 2.0% over Foresight-trained models while also producing more novel and diverse outputs, across all eight model families we test. The advantage propagates downstream: coding agents conditioned on Hindsight trajectories produce research artifacts with higher executability, scientific grounding, and utility than those conditioned on Foresight trajectories. This suggests that outcome-anchored ideation reduces the cognitive burden on downstream agents, freeing them to explore more creatively. SciSense offers both a practical tool for augmenting LLM-driven research workflows and a principled testbed for studying how planning shapes scientific discovery.
articles.titleCn: 结构赋予自由：如何通过受限的意义建构产生更具创新性的研究产出
articles.abstractCn: 科学发现是一个扩展的构思过程——包括调研前期工作、形成假设和细化推理——然而现有的LLM研究代理将这一阶段视为简短的序幕，尽管它在研究中起着核心作用。我们引入了SciSense，一个基于意义建构的框架，将构思过程操作化为一个包含八个认知阶段的有序序列（Pirolli和Card，2005）。我们构建了SciSense-Traj数据集，包含12万条条件化引用的研究轨迹，分为两种模式：Hindsight模式，其中LLM从论文引用的作品重构到论文本身的过程；Foresight模式，其中LLM从相同的引用提出新的方向。我们将这些提炼为SciSense-LM，一个涵盖30亿到700亿参数的意义建构LLM家族。与宽松监督促进探索的假设相反，Hindsight训练的模型在所有八个模型家族中，比Foresight训练的模型提高了2.0%的轨迹质量，同时产生了更多新颖和多样化的输出。这一优势向下传递：基于Hindsight轨迹的编码代理产生的研究成果比基于Foresight轨迹的代理具有更高的可执行性、科学基础和实用性。这表明以结果为导向的构思减少了下游代理的认知负担，使他们能够更富有创造力地探索。SciSense既提供了一个实用的工具来增强LLM驱动的研发工作流程，也提供了一个原则性的试验平台来研究规划如何塑造科学发现。

articles.title: Decoupling Search from Reasoning: A Vendor-Agnostic Grounding Architecture for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Production LLM agents increasingly depend on real-time search, yet native search grounding bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency, and generation behavior behind a single model-provider boundary. This coupling makes grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse, or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. We present Decoupled Search Grounding (DSG), a vendor-agnostic boundary that moves grounding outside the reasoning model through an MCP-compatible gateway, exposing provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact plus semantic caching as first-class controls. Across five frontier models on SimpleQA, FreshQA, and HotpotQA, native search leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA, but DSG exposes a stronger frontier when control matters: on SimpleQA it nearly matches native accuracy (86.1% vs. 87.7%) at 91% lower search cost, preserves concise answer contracts, and reaches a 99.4% warm-cache hit rate with 68% lower latency. Deployed as a shared production grounding layer for large-scale agentic workloads with interchangeable models, DSG matches native-search accuracy on an e-commerce query-understanding (QIU) workload while cutting search cost by over 98%. Real-time grounding is best treated as an optimizable interface boundary, not a fixed model feature.
articles.comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026; 16 pages, 9 figure
articles.titleCn: 将搜索与推理解耦：面向LLM代理的供应商无关的 grounding 架构
articles.abstractCn: 生产LLM代理越来越依赖实时搜索，但原生搜索基础捆绑了检索策略、提供商选择、证据注入、成本、延迟和生成行为于单一模型-提供商边界之后。这种耦合使得基础难以检查、调整、复用或移植，并可能引发搜索诱导的冗余，破坏严格的输出合同。我们提出了解耦搜索基础（DSG），一个与供应商无关的边界，通过兼容MCP的网关将基础移出推理模型，将提供商路由、源感知上下文渲染、配置的回退、检索深度控制和精确及语义缓存作为一等控制进行暴露。在SimpleQA、FreshQA和HotpotQA的五个前沿模型上，原生搜索在时效性敏感的FreshQA上领先，但当控制至关重要时，DSG展现出更强的前沿：在SimpleQA上，它以91%的搜索成本降低，接近原生准确率（86.1% vs. 87.7%），保持简洁的答案合同，并达到99.4%的暖缓存命中率，延迟降低68%。作为可互换模型的规模化代理工作负载的共享生产基础层部署时，DSG在电商查询理解（QIU）工作负载上匹配原生搜索准确率，同时将搜索成本削减超过98%。实时基础应被视为一个可优化的接口边界，而非固定的模型特性。

articles.title: BehaviorBench: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Behavioral Science Tasks
articles.abstract: Foundation models have been increasingly applied to behavioral science domains such as psychology, sociology, and economics. While these models show promise in tasks such as survey response prediction and human-subject experiment simulation, there remains no systematic understanding of how well they perform across diverse behavioral science tasks. We introduce BehaviorBench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates foundation models along four core capabilities: (1) behavior prediction and simulation, (2) strategic decision-making, (3) subject-trait inference, and (4) behavioral knowledge application. Crucially, BehaviorBench evaluates model outputs at both the individual and distributional levels, capturing not only per-subject accuracy but also population-level alignment, an essential requirement for behavioral validity. Our evaluation shows that BehaviorBench remains challenging for leading general-purpose LLMs and behavior foundation models that are specifically trained with behavioral data. We find that individual-level and distributional performance do not always align. General-purpose LLMs tend to underestimate the diversity of human responses, whereas behavior foundation models often lag behind at individual-level prediction. Our investigation further demonstrates how fine-tuning on diverse behavioral data can improve both individual-level prediction and distributional alignment, balancing these two objectives. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation at both individual and distributional levels, establishing BehaviorBench as a foundation for developing and assessing behaviorally aligned AI systems. Our BehaviorBench and models can be accessed via https://umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench/
articles.titleCn: 行为基准测试：用于行为科学任务的基础模型评测
articles.abstractCn: 基础模型已越来越多地应用于心理学、社会学、经济学等行为科学领域。尽管这些模型在调查响应预测和人类受试者实验模拟等任务中展现出潜力，但目前仍缺乏对它们在不同行为科学任务中的表现进行系统性的理解。我们介绍了BehaviorBench，这是一个全面的基准测试，它沿四个核心能力评估基础模型：(1)行为预测与模拟，(2)策略性决策，(3)受试者特质推断，以及(4)行为知识应用。关键的是，BehaviorBench在个体和分布层面评估模型输出，不仅捕捉到每个受试者的准确性，还捕捉到群体层面的契合度，这是行为有效性的基本要求。我们的评估表明，BehaviorBench对领先的通用大型语言模型（LLM）和行为基础模型（这些模型专门使用行为数据进行训练）仍然具有挑战性。我们发现个体层面和分布层面的表现并不总是契合。通用LLM往往低估了人类响应的多样性，而行为基础模型在个体层面预测方面常常落后。我们的研究进一步展示了如何通过对多样化行为数据进行微调来提高个体层面的预测和分布层面的契合度，从而平衡这两个目标。我们的结果表明，在个体和分布层面进行评估至关重要，这确立了BehaviorBench作为开发和评估行为契合型人工智能系统的基石。我们的BehaviorBench和模型可通过https://umich-foreseer.github.io/behaviorbench/获取。

articles.title: Lost in Context Compaction: When LLM Systems Drop Side Constraints
articles.abstract: When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We study Side Constraints (SCs), user-issued instructions such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that constrain an LLM's behavior across subsequent turns but can be silently dropped during compaction. In an inbox experiment, an agent deleted emails without approval in 30/100 sessions after compaction, compared with none before compaction. To systematically evaluate SC preservation, we introduce CONPACT, an evaluation suite measuring semantic retention and downstream compliance across three scenarios: multi-turn chat, multi-turn tool use, and long-horizon research. The evaluated compactors retain only 17% of injected SCs on average. Loss occurs across compactors and settings, with retention varying by compactor, context length, SC framing, and injection location. We propose an SC extractor that maintains constraints separately from the task summary and appends them to the compacted context, achieving over 90% retention across all three scenarios without modifying the compactor or LLM. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ZhiqiEliWang/compaction-integrity.
articles.titleCn: 在上下文压缩中迷失：当大型语言模型系统丢弃侧约束时
articles.abstractCn: 当上下文窗口压力过大时，大型语言模型系统会压缩先前的上下文以继续进行中的任务。我们研究了侧约束（SCs），例如用户发出的指令“在我不确认之前不要删除任何邮件”，这些指令会约束大型语言模型在后续回合中的行为，但在压缩过程中可能会被无声地忽略。在一个收件箱实验中，代理在压缩后的100个会话中有30个未经批准删除了邮件，而压缩前则没有。为了系统地评估侧约束的保留情况，我们引入了CONPACT，这是一个评估套件，用于衡量三个场景中的语义保留和下游合规性：多回合聊天、多回合工具使用和长时程研究。评估的压缩器平均仅保留了17%注入的侧约束。损失发生在不同的压缩器和设置中，保留率因压缩器、上下文长度、侧约束表述方式和注入位置而异。我们提出了一种侧约束提取器，它将约束与任务摘要分开维护，并将它们附加到压缩后的上下文中，在所有三个场景中实现了超过90%的保留率，而无需修改压缩器或大型语言模型。代码和数据可在https://github.com/ZhiqiEliWang/compaction-integrity获取。

articles.title: Draft-KV: Learning Useful Latent Communication Between Language Models
articles.abstract: Latent communication passes internal states between language models instead of decoded text, but higher receiver accuracy does not show that the receiver used the message content. Across five method-dataset pairs, replacing each message with one from an unrelated question changes accuracy by at most 0.60 points, even when communication adds 15.44 points over the receiver alone. Thus the interface can supply the gain while making the sharer dispensable. Draft-KV instead sends the key-value states formed while the sharer drafts an answer to the current question. Linear projections place these states in a side memory read through a gated attention branch, and progressive training moves from message reconstruction to answer supervision under a guard on harm from mismatched messages. Both models remain frozen and the interface trains 1.05M parameters, 348x fewer than C2C. With a Qwen3-8B sharer, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct receiver reaches 78.04% on MMLU-Redux, versus 37.45% alone and 36.40% with reassigned messages. At fixed interface size, scaling the sharer from 0.6B to 8B raises accuracy from 46.11% to 78.04%; communication also transfers to held-out tasks and can exceed both models when each holds different evidence.
articles.comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/Svardfox/Draft-KV; Corrected an erroneous conference-publication header left by the LaTeX template; scientific content unchanged
articles.titleCn: 草稿-KV：学习语言模型之间的有用潜在通信
articles.abstractCn: 潜在通信在语言模型之间传递内部状态，而非解码文本，但接收者准确率的提高并不表明其使用了消息内容。在五种方法-数据集对中，将每条消息替换为来自无关问题的消息，准确率最多变化0.60分，即使通信比单独接收者多增加了15.44分。因此，界面可以提供增益，同时使分享者变得非必需。Draft-KV则发送分享者在回答当前问题时形成的键值状态。线性投影将这些状态放置在通过门控注意力分支读取的侧边存储器中，渐进式训练从消息重建转向答案监督，并在防止不匹配消息造成伤害的防护下进行。两个模型都保持冻结状态，界面训练了1.05M参数，比C2C少348倍。使用Qwen3-8B分享者时，冻结的Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct接收者在MMLU-Redux上达到78.04%，单独使用时为37.45%，使用重新分配的消息时为36.40%。在固定界面大小下，将分享者规模从0.6B扩展到8B，准确率从46.11%提高到78.04%；通信也能转移到保留任务，并且当每个模型持有不同证据时，其准确率可以超过两个模型。

articles.title: Marking Contour Tones in Yorùbá: A Typographic and Computational Proposal
articles.abstract: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. These are especially notable for personal names and lexical items whose conventional spellings avoid vowel lengthening that would otherwise provide a host syllable for the second tone. A particular concern is a class of names in which the conventional spelling does not just omit tonal information but inverts the meaning of said name, sometimes asserting the opposite of what the name intends. This paper describes the problem, illustrates the inadequacy of current solutions, and proposes the adoption of the caron and circumflex marks. These are symbols with precedent in Yorùbá phonological scholarship since Olmsted (1951), used as orthographic conventions on single vowels to encode rising and falling contour tones, making them accessible for the first time through standard keyboard input and computational text processing. The proposal is supported by an implementation in the WriteYoruba keyboard and the TTSYoruba speech synthesizer, whose architecture and listener evaluation are reported separately (Tubosun et al., 2026).
articles.comment: 13 pages. v5: proposes the caron and circumflex as a revision of the standard Yoruba orthography, with a formal recommendation (Section 5) for their use in lexicography, reference writing and computational resources; notes remaining gaps, including mid-tone vowel sequences, for future work
articles.titleCn: 在约鲁巴语中标记轮廓音：一种排版和计算方案
articles.abstractCn: 约鲁巴语是一种声调语言，其中音调轮廓给持续的拼写带来了持续的挑战。这些挑战在个人姓名和词汇项目上尤为明显，其常规拼写避免了元音长度变化，而元音长度变化本可为第二声提供一个宿主音节。一个特别值得关注的问题是某一类姓名，其常规拼写不仅省略了声调信息，还反转了该姓名的含义，有时甚至表达了与姓名意图相反的内容。本文描述了这个问题，说明了当前解决方案的不足，并提出了采用变音符号和波浪号的建议。这些符号在约鲁巴语音韵学研究中自奥姆斯泰德（1951年）以来已有先例，作为单音节的拼写规范来编码上升和下降的音调轮廓，通过标准键盘输入和计算文本处理，它们首次变得易于使用。该提议得到了WriteYoruba键盘和TTSYoruba语音合成器的实现支持，其架构和听众评估将在别处单独报告（Tubosun等人，2026年）。

articles.title: Clean: Second-order LLM Training at Linear Memory Cost via Nystr{ö}m Sketching
articles.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) entails a fundamental trade-off: memory-efficient optimizers such as Adam discard cross-parameter curvature, whereas full-curvature methods such as SOAP can accelerate convergence at prohibitive memory costs. We introduce Clean, a memory-efficient and full-curvature optimizer designed to resolve this bottleneck. Clean leverages the randomized Nystrom method to accurately approximate the left and right preconditioners in SOAP, and to reduce the optimizer's memory complexity from quadratic to linear in terms of model dimensions. We subsequently reintegrate the off-subspace components to capture curvature information beyond the low-rank approximation, preserving rich curvature at minimal memory cost. We further propose Q-Clean, a low-precision variant that aggressively compresses optimizer states. Q-Clean reduces optimizer memory consumption by over 50% compared to Muon when pre-training a LLaMA-1.3B architecture, all while maintaining strong and competitive predictive performance. Notably, Clean operates with a smaller optimizer-state footprint than standard AdamW while reaching AdamW's final performance 26% faster in wall-clock time. Furthermore, our methods uniquely enable the pre-training of a 13B-parameter model on a single 80GB GPU, providing a scalable, efficient, and accessible approach to large-scale model optimization.
articles.titleCn: 清洁：通过Nyström Sketching以线性内存成本进行二阶LLM训练
articles.abstractCn: 训练大型语言模型（LLM）存在一个基本权衡：内存高效的优化器如Adam会舍弃跨参数曲率，而全曲率方法如SOAP虽能加速收敛，但需付出高昂的内存成本。我们引入Clean，这是一种内存高效且支持全曲率的优化器，旨在解决这一瓶颈。Clean利用随机Nystrom方法精确逼近SOAP中的左右预条件器，并将优化器的内存复杂度从模型维度的平方级降低到线性级。随后，我们重新整合了超子空间外的成分，以捕捉低秩逼近之外的曲率信息，在极低的内存成本下保留丰富的曲率特性。此外，我们进一步提出了Q-Clean，一种低精度变体，通过激进地压缩优化器状态。在预训练LLaMA-1.3B架构时，Q-Clean相较于Muon将优化器内存消耗降低了50%以上，同时保持了强大且具有竞争力的预测性能。值得注意的是，Clean的优化器状态占用量小于标准AdamW，但在墙钟时间上比AdamW快26%即可达到其最终性能。此外，我们的方法独特地实现了在单个80GB GPU上预训练一个13B参数模型，为大规模模型优化提供了一种可扩展、高效且易于访问的途径。

articles.title: Nucleus Speculative Decoding: Plausibility-Aware Verification Beyond Exact Distribution
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight draft model propose tokens that a target model verifies in parallel. However, its standard acceptance rule, designed for exact distribution correction, rejects tokens to which the draft assigns excess probability, even when the target finds them highly plausible: over half of the rejected tokens lie inside the target's own nucleus. Since verification dominates the cost of SD, these rejections waste its most expensive operation. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a plausibility-aware verification rule that accepts a draft token if it passes the standard test or belongs to the target nucleus, while keeping SD's residual correction and bonus sampling unchanged. NSD requires no training or extra forward passes and is compatible with any drafting mechanism. Because it preserves SD's recovery rule, its deviation from the target distribution can be characterized exactly: we prove that the single-step total variation error equals the draft's excess probability inside the target nucleus, which is precisely NSD's gain in acceptance probability. NSD thus trades fidelity for acceptance at an exact one-to-one rate, and we further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds. Across six target models and five mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, NSD achieves the highest throughput among all compared methods, with speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and $3.15\times$ over standard SD, while improving accuracy over SD on five of the six models and nearly halving verification time per output token. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding.
articles.titleCn: 推测解码核：超越精确分布的合理性感知验证
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码（SD）通过让轻量级的草稿模型提出令目标模型并行验证的标记来加速自回归生成。然而，其标准的接受规则是为精确分布校正而设计的，会拒绝草稿模型分配过高概率的标记，即使目标模型认为这些标记高度合理：超过一半被拒绝的标记位于目标模型自身的核内。由于验证主导了SD的成本，这些拒绝操作浪费了其最昂贵的操作。我们引入核推测解码（NSD），这是一种考虑合理性的验证规则，如果草稿标记通过标准测试或属于目标核，则接受该标记，同时保持SD的残差校正和奖励采样不变。NSD无需训练或额外的前向传递，且与任何草稿机制兼容。因为它保留了SD的恢复规则，其与目标分布的偏差可以被精确描述：我们证明单步总变差误差等于草稿模型在目标核内的超额概率，这恰好是NSD在接受概率上的增益。因此，NSD以精确的一对一比率用保真度换取接受度，并进一步推导出序列级保真度界限。在六个目标模型和五个数学推理和代码生成基准测试中，NSD在所有比较方法中实现了最高的吞吐量，相较于自回归解码速度提升高达5.16倍，相较于标准SD速度提升高达3.15倍，同时在六个模型中的五个上提高了准确性，并将每个输出标记的验证时间几乎减半。我们的代码可在https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding获取。

articles.title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
articles.abstract: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.
articles.titleCn: 序列证明器：为形式化、可验证的SMT推理训练智能体
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Sequent-Prover，这是一系列使用验证器的语言模型代理，以及生成它们的后训练框架。代理在可执行的SMT-LIB草稿纸上进行推理：它们编写完整的SMT-LIB程序，在回合间查询Z3，检查求解器反馈，修复形式化表述，并以明确的答案终止。我们的方法，即验证器条件轨迹蒸馏，从噪声的教师提议策略开始，通过采样多回合轨迹，保留正确、非平凡、有根据且可执行的轨迹成功尾部，然后应用监督微调和轨迹级偏好优化。由于求解器成功本身并不能保证语义忠实性，我们评估了任务准确率、k样本可靠性和SMT程序质量。在37个基准测试和每个模型家族的7,254个问题中，后训练将4B模型的每次尝试准确率从85.6%提高到97.0%，四样本全正确可靠性（pass^4）从64.1%提高到91.7%。它还降低了平均SMT调用次数从4.10次到2.52次，每次尝试的token数从18.97k到12.72k。Sequent-Prover代理给出的答案有可执行的形式化工件支持。

articles.title: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
articles.abstract: Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.
articles.titleCn: 正确的答案是否具有稳定的潜在知识支持？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常根据其输出的正确性进行评估。然而，输出正确性并不能证明支持答案的潜在知识是否具有稳定的内部表征。因此，我们提出了潜在状态稳定性（LSS）和知识拓扑稳定性（KTS）来分别研究单个知识状态及其关系结构的稳定性。具体而言，我们首先在每种激发条件下分别对模型关于相同知识的内部表征进行平均。以基线条件下的平均表征作为参考，我们移除共享的偏移量以获得校正后的表征。然后，我们将LSS定义为每个校正后的表征与其参考表征之间的距离，该距离相对于同类知识项之间的典型距离进行归一化。我们将KTS定义为同类知识项之间有序成对表征距离的跨条件一致性。接下来，我们构建了EpiStableBench，其中包含4,411个涵盖事实知识和数学推理的项目，以及76,766个受控查询。在来自四个系列的16个LLM中，即使在基线条件下正确回答的项目中，表征稳定性也差异很大。在模型内部，更高的稳定性通常对应于在保留的激发条件下更高的准确率；在模型之间，稳定性并不始终随着模型规模或整体准确率的增加而提高。同时，我们提出了LatentDPO来学习一个考虑潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略。实验结果表明，将LatentDPO与多种现有编辑方法相结合，可以持续提高编辑成功率和跨不同表达的泛化能力。

articles.title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.
articles.comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 19 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables
articles.titleCn: 北还是南？诊断大型语言模型对朝鲜语言、社会和知识的理解
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在多语言问答方面取得了显著进展，但它们理解低资源社会语言学语境的能力仍待深入探索。我们以朝鲜为独特试验场，研究其数十年的分裂导致与韩国在词汇、正字法、规范和意识形态话语上存在显著差异。我们引入了LENS（朝鲜社会语言文化评估），这是一个经人类验证的基准，包含1765个问题，从三个维度评估LLM：语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角一致性以及领域特定知识。评估多种最新的LLM后，我们发现它们在朝鲜语输入上的表现略有下降，社会文化视角一致性的差距更大，且领域特定知识存在严重局限。定性分析揭示，模型常将正式机构与生活现实混淆，投射自由民主的假设，或依赖粗略的刻板印象。我们的结果表明，仅凭语言相似性并不能保证社会文化或领域特定理解，突显了为代表性不足的文化和政治语境提供基础评估资源的关键需求。

articles.title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
articles.abstract: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length. The central result appears after post-training. Reinforcement learning across four verifiable task environments improves mathematics, graduate-level science, and instruction following, but degrades Indic extractive question answering because the rewards do not require an answer in the requested language. The share of Indic extraction items answered in English rises from 8.7% to 91.7%. Accuracy conditional on answering in the target script roughly doubles, which is consistent with preserved reading ability but is measured on a self-selected subset. Two unreleased studies test repairs. A scoped Indic reward restores the language convention. A 26B-A4B generative judge outperforms a 235B-parameter model on RM-Bench, and distillation restores 81% of the capabilities displaced by optimizing against it. Relative to the architecture-identical starting checkpoint, the released model gains 5.2 points on an Indic aggregate while giving up 1.7 points of English retention. The unreleased Indic-aware branch trades further, gaining 14.6 Indic points at a cost of 5.4 in English. A planned FP8 release reduces the artifact to 32GB with near-zero mean change across 32 paired benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 一个以印度语为主的推理模型
articles.abstractCn: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B 是一个用于推理、指令遵循和工具使用的长上下文混合 Mamba-Transformer 专家模型，支持英语和八种印度语言。该模型基于 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 检查点构建，保留了 52 层的主干网络，并修改了词汇表、训练数据和后训练目标。通过将 131,072 个 token 的模型扩展到 163,072 个 token，印度语言平均生育率降低了 38.6%。新的嵌入行在主干网络更新前从其上游分解中初始化并进行预热。持续预训练阶段添加了广泛的英语-印度语数据、高质量的退火过程以及在 131,072 个 token 序列长度上的直接训练。核心结果出现在后训练阶段。在四个可验证任务环境中的强化学习提升了数学、研究生级科学和指令遵循能力，但由于奖励不要求使用请求语言，因此降低了印度语抽取式问答能力。印度语抽取项用英语回答的比例从 8.7% 提升至 91.7%。在目标脚本回答条件下的准确率几乎翻倍，这与保留的阅读能力一致，但测量的是自我选择的子集。两项未发布的测试验证了修复效果。一个限定范围的印度语奖励恢复了语言规范。一个 26B-A4B 生成式判别器在 RM-Bench 上优于一个 235B 参数模型，蒸馏过程恢复了 81% 的被优化过程取代的能力。与架构相同的起始检查点相比，发布的模型在印度语综合指标上提升了 5.2 分，但在英语保留上牺牲了 1.7 分。未发布的印度语感知分支进行了进一步权衡，以 5.4 分英语的代价获得了 14.6 分印度语提升。计划中的 FP8 发布将模型大小压缩至 32GB，在 32 项配对基准测试中平均变化接近于零。

articles.title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
articles.abstract: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved English performance.
articles.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 原位印地语标记器扩展与Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B的持续预训练
articles.abstractCn: 我们未改变Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B的主干架构，将其适配了八种印度语言。我们通过持续字节对编码和AdaptMix再平衡，将词汇表从131,072个词条扩展至163,072个词条，使每个词的token数量减少了38.6%。我们通过平均原始输入和输出行来初始化新行，然后在90%的印度语和10%的英语文本上进行训练，之后再更新主干。持续预训练通过广泛训练、高质量退火和长上下文训练，处理了大约1.27万亿个token。退火后的检查点在印度语MILU基准上提升了12.9分，但在英语MMLU上下降了3.4分。我们还报告了实际负面结果。直接token添加的表现不如持续字节对编码。AdamW权重衰减改变了本应保持固定的行。在印度语占比较高的验证集上，困惑度并未选择能最好保留英语性能的学习率。
